name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Syzygy.exists_affine_syzygy
title: Affine short syzygy: M bounded integer vectors have a vanishing {-1,0,1} combination with coefficient sum 0
statement: Let v_1, ..., v_M be vectors in Z^d with entries in [-B, B]. If (2MB+1)^d (M+1) < 2^M, there is a nonzero alpha in {-1,0,1}^M with sum_j alpha_j = 0 and sum_j alpha_j v_j = 0. Normalizing by the first nonzero coefficient, one of the vectors is an affine {-1,0,1} combination of later ones. This is the counting step of the affine short-syzygy barrier against data-only witness-indexed hybrids for witness encryption with constant-degree noisy-linear decryption (note pq-we-affine-syzygy-barrier).
